Exploitability_explanation: Vulnerability affects the http3 package (QPACK decoding). While quic-go is used for transport in frp, there is no usage of the http3 package or HTTP/3 server/client features. API call not confirmed.
Vulnerability affects golang.org/x/crypto/ssh/agent. Search of the codebase confirmed that the ssh/agent package is not imported or used anywhere. API call not confirmed.

Vulnerability affects GSSAPI authentication in the ssh package. The vulnerable API ssh.NewServerConn is used in pkg/ssh/server.go, but GSSAPI is not enabled in the ServerConfig. Probability is low but API usage is confirmed.
Vulnerability affects pion/dtls AES-GCM nonce generation. This is an indirect dependency likely pulled in by pion/stun, but it is not directly used in the frp codebase. API call not confirmed.
